questions.question: If (x²-1)/(x)=8, then what is the value of (x⁶-1)/(x³)= ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

(x²-1)/(x)=8

**Formula used:**

If (x - (1)/(x)) = k, then (x³ - (1)/(x³)) = k³ + 3k

**Calculation:**

⇒ (x²)/(x) - (1)/(x) = 8

⇒ x - (1)/(x) = 8

⇒ (x⁶-1)/(x³) = x³ - (1)/(x³)

⇒ x³ - (1)/(x³) = 8³ + 3 × 8

⇒ 512 + 24

⇒ 536

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**

questions.question: Radius of a circle is 10 cm. What will be the angle made by a chord of length 20 cm on the circumference of this circle?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The radius of a circle is 10 cm.

A chord of length 20 cm is drawn.

**Concept used:**

The diameter of a circle subtends an angle of 90° at the circumference of the circle.

The diameter is the largest chord of a circle.

The length of the diameter = 2 × Radius

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87be8185c0ebee90915499fefb516174a64790635427e00177e936a770d8cf73.png] 

Let the radius of the circle be R cm.

According to the concept,

R = 10 cm

So, Diameter = 2 × R = 2 × 10 = 20 cm

According to the question,

The chord has a length of 20 cm.

A diameter divides the circle into two semi-circles, each having an angle of 90 degrees at the circumference of the circle.

So, the angle made by the chord (diameter in this case) at the circumference of the circle is 90 degrees.

Therefore, the correct answer is 1) 90 degrees.

questions.question: 12 men can do a work in 8 days while 4 boys can do it in 40 days. In how many days 9 boys and 3 men together will complete the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

12 men can do a work in 8 days while 4 boys can do it in 40 days.

**Concept Used:**

M₁D₁ = M₂D₂

**Calculation:**

⇒ 12M × 8 = 4B × 40

⇒ 3M = 5B

⇒ M : B = 5 : 3

Total work = 12 × 5 × 8 = 480

9 boys and 3 men together will complete the same work in = 480/(9 × 3 + 3 × 5)

⇒ 480/42

⇒ 80/7 days

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**

questions.question:
The line chart given below shows the expenditure of two companies R and S in different years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e01f58ef9bd963206ca0bf95beae1fdcecd9234a6b2766d16f2ad1c73bbb359e.png] 

Which of the following statement is NOT correct?

I. The expenditure of R in year Y1 and Y2 together is (Approximate) 81.66 percent of the expenditure of S in year Y3 and Y4 together

II. The total expenditure of company S is (Approximate) 112.12 percent of the total expenditure of company R.
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Statement I:

The expenditure of R in year Y1 and Y2 together = 600 + 500 = 1100

The expenditure of S in year Y3 and Y4 together = 700 + 500 = 1200

Percentage of the expenditure of R in year Y1 and Y2 together to the expenditure of S in year Y3 and Y4 together = 1100/1200 × 100 = 91.66%

Statement I is not correct.

Statement II:

Total expenditure of company S = 1200 + 900 + 700 + 500 + 400 = 3700

Total expenditure of company R = 600 + 500 + 800 + 400 + 1000 = 3300

Percentage of the total expenditure of company S to the total expenditure of company R = 3700/3300 × 100 = 112.12%

Statement II is correct.

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: A chair is marked for Rs. 210 and sold for Rs. 189. Find the discount rate for this transaction.
questions.solution:
Given:

Marked price = (M.P) = Rs. 210

Selling price = (S.P) = Rs. 189

Formula used:

If marked price is M.P, selling price is S.P and discount is D, then

Discount = M.P - S.P

Rate of discount = (100/M.P) × Discount

Calculation:

Discount = 210 - 189 = Rs. 21

So, Rate of discount = (21/210) × 100 = 10 %

∴ The rate of discount is 10 %

questions.question: The ratio of the volume of first and second cylinder is 32 ∶ 9 and the ratio of their heights is 8 ∶ 9. If the area of the base of the second cylinder is 616 cm², then what will be the radius of the first cylinder?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Volume ratio = 32 ∶ 9

Ratio of their heights is 8 ∶ 9

Area of the base of the second cylinder is 616 cm2

**Concept Used:**

Volume of cylinder = πr²h

**Calculation:**

Volume of the cylinder can be written as 32y and 9y

Height of the cylinder can be written as 8h and 9h

Since we know that the Volume of cylinder is Area of base × height

⇒ Volume of second cylinder = 616 × 9h

Let the radius of first cylinder be r

⇒ base area of first cylinder = πr²

Volume of first cylinder = πr² × 8h

Their ratios can be written as

⇒ 616 × 9h/ (πr² × 8h) = 9/32

Put π = 22/7

⇒ (22r2 × 8)/(616 × 9 × 7)/ = 32/9

⇒ r² = (616 × 9 × 32 × 7)/(9 × 22 × 8)

⇒ r = 28

∴ Radius of first cylinder is 28 cm.

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: Ritika purchased 'x' kg wheat at Rs.30/kg and sold 8 kg of this at Rs. 'x' per kg and remaining at Rs. 45/kg. Overall profit percent earned is 10%, then what quantity of wheat Ritika sold at Rs. 45/kg?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Overall Selling Price = 30 × 1.10 = Rs. 33/kg.

Equating total SP parts: 8x + 45(x − 8) = 33x

53x − 360 = 33x ⇒ 20x = 360 ⇒ x = 18

Quantity sold at Rs. 45/kg = x − 8 = 18 − 8 = 10 kg.

**∴ The correct answer is 10 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) = Rs. 30/kg, Overall profit = 10%

Quantity sold at Rs. x/kg = 8 kg

Quantity sold at Rs. 45/kg = (x − 8) kg

**Formula Used:**

Mean SP = CP × (100 + Profit%) ÷ 100

Alligation ratio = (SP₂ − Mean SP) / (Mean SP − SP₁)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd1e397aa89bdb403bbae6ee7345ab77a8827f5393cb629151f5ae37df3dfb4c.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Mean Selling Price = 30 × 1.1 = Rs. 33/kg

⇒ Using the Alligation ratio: 8 / (x − 8) = (45 − 33) / (33 − x)

⇒ 8 / (x − 8) = 12 / (33 − x)

⇒ 2 / (x − 8) = 3 / (33 − x)

⇒ 2 × (33 − x) = 3 × (x − 8)

⇒ 66 − 2x = 3x − 24

⇒ 5x = 90

⇒ x = 18

⇒ Quantity sold at Rs. 45/kg = 18 − 8 = 10 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 10 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mixtures & Alligation Rule

It allows finding the ratio in which two ingredients at given prices must be mixed to produce a mixture of a desired price: Quantity 1 / Quantity 2 = (Price 2 − Mean Price) / (Mean Price − Price 1).

Profit and Loss Basics

Selling Price (SP) is calculated as CP × (100 + Profit%) ÷ 100. When multiple parts are sold at different prices, the overall SP is the weighted average of the individual SPs.

Replacement Method

When a quantity 'y' is replaced 'n' times from a total mixture 'x', the remaining quantity of the original substance is given by x × (1 − y/x)ⁿ.
</p

questions.question: A car moves at the speed of 108 km/hr after repairing and moves at the speed of 72 km/hr before repairing. It covers a distance of x km in 3 hours after repairing. How much time will it take to cover a distance of 5 x km before repairing?

Time = Distance/Speed

Distance = Time × Speed

x = 108 × 3 = 324 km

Distance before repairing = 5x

Time before repairing = 1620/72

135/6 = 22 hours 30 minutes

questions.question: The ratio of incomes of P and Q is 1 ∶ 2. Ratio of income of Q and R is 3 ∶ 2. If one-third of P's income is Rs. 4400 less than the half of P's income, then what is the Q's income?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of incomes of P and Q is 1:2

The ratio of income of Q and R is 3:2

One-third of P's income is Rs. 4400 less than half of P's income.

**Calculation:**

P's income = x

Q's income = 2x (since the ratio of P's income to Q's income is 1:2)

According to the given information:

One-third of P's income is Rs. 4400 less than half of P's income.

(1/3)x = (1/2)× x - 4400

To simplify the equation, we can multiply both sides by 6 to get rid of the fractions:

x/2 - x/3 = 4400

x/6 = 4400

x = 26400

So

Q's income = 2x = 2 × 26400 = 52800

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: What is the value of the expression 1 - 7 + 2 - 8 + 3 - 9 + 4 - 10 + _______ to 100 terms?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

The given expression alternates between adding and subtracting the numbers 1, 7, 2, 8, 3, 9, 4, 10, and so on.

We can observe that the numbers being added increase by 1 each time, while the numbers being subtracted also increase by 1 each time.

To find the value of the expression to 100 terms, we can group the terms into pairs.

Each pair consists of a positive number and its negative counterpart.

The sum of each pair is always -6 because (-7 + 1 = -6, -8 + 2 = -6, -9 + 3 = -6, and so on).

Since we have 100 terms in total, we can form 50 pairs.

Each pair sums up to -6, so the sum of the 100 terms is:

50 pairs × (-6) = -300

Therefore, the value of the expression 1 - 7 + 2 - 8 + 3 - 9 + 4 - 10 + ... to 100 terms is -300.

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: If -sin θ + cosec θ = 6, then what is the value of sin θ + cosec θ?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

-sin θ + cosec θ = 6

⇒ -sin θ + 1/sin θ = 6

⇒ 1 - sin² θ = 6 sin θ 

⇒ sin2 θ + 6 sin θ - 1 = 0

Apply quadratic roots formula,

x = (-b ± √b² - 4ac)/2a

Here x = sinθ , a = 1, b = 6, c = -1

⇒ sinθ = (-6 ± √6² - 4 × (-1))/2

⇒ sinθ = (-6 ± √40)/2

⇒ sinθ = (-3 ± √10)

⇒ sin θ + cosec θ = sin θ + 6 + sin θ (cosec θ = 6 + sin θ)

⇒ 2sin θ + 6

⇒ 2(-3 ± √10) + 6

⇒ -6 ± 2√10 + 6

⇒ ± 2√10

⇒ √40

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: If a³ + 3a² + 3a = 63, then the value of a² + 2a is:
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let's solve the given equation a³ + 3a² + 3a = 63 and find the value of a² + 2a

We can factor the left side of the equation by recognizing it as a cube of a binomial:

(a + 1)³ = a³ + 3a² + 3a + 1 

Comparing this with the given equation, we have:

(a + 1)³ = 63 + 1

Taking the cube root of both sides, we get:

a + 1 = ∛(64)

Simplifying further, we have:

a + 1 = 4

Subtracting 1 from both sides:

a = 4 - 1

a = 3

Now we can find the value of a² + 2a:

a² + 2a = 3² + 2(3) = 9 + 6 = 15

Therefore, the value of a² + 2a is 15.

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: The average of 16 numbers is 35. It was found later that four numbers 18, 17, 24 and 35 were taken by mistake. What is the new average after removing these numbers?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Original average of 16 numbers = 35

Net deviation of removed numbers (18, 17, 24, 35) = (−17) + (−18) + (−11) + 0 = −46

Removing numbers with a negative net deviation increases the average of the remaining values.

Increase in average = 46 ÷ 12 = 3.83

New average = 35 + 3.83 = 38.83

**∴ The correct answer is 38.83.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of 16 numbers = 35

Removed numbers = 18, 17, 24 and 35

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of numbers ÷ Total numbers

 
 
 
• 
 4 removed
 12 remaining
 Sum = 94
 Sum = 466
 New Avg = 38.83
 Total: 16 numbers, Avg = 35, Sum = 560

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total sum of 16 numbers = 16 × 35 = 560

⇒ Sum of removed numbers = 18 + 17 + 24 + 35 = 94

⇒ Total sum of remaining 12 numbers = 560 − 94 = 466

⇒ New average = 466 ÷ 12

⇒ New average = 233 ÷ 6 = 38.83

**∴ The correct answer is 38.83.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Basic Concept

The average of a set of numbers is the sum of the values divided by the total count of numbers.

Net Deviation Method

Removing items with a net negative deviation from the overall average increases the average of the remaining items. Similarly, removing positive deviations decreases the average.

Weighted Average

When combining two groups, the combined average is calculated as (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).
</p
